meta.tolerance: numbers within 0.5 px, everything else exactly equal, across engines and viewports (label.h, the engine's text-box height, is not compared)

schema.cases: cases[id].markup; cases[id][ctx][state] = summarize(record, { withOutline: state === focus, extra }); cases[id][ctx].extras = { count } | { glyph, shapes } | { wrapper } | { color, stroke }
schema.quick: quick[id][width] = { strip:{w,h}, chips:[{ text, left, top, w, h, pressed, tone }], rows, elements, display, flexWrap, columnGap, rowGap, alignItems }
schema.roving: roving[scenario] = [{ key, at, tabindex, pressed, prevented }]
schema.ellipsis: ellipsis[nameId][width] = { kind, root, headW, tailW, tailLeft, headScroll, headClient, rootScroll, rootClient, cut, elements, text }; G-scale125 = G under data-text-scale 125
schema.paints: paints[kitThemeId][id][state] = { color, bg, image, border, outline, icon, glyph }
schema.inContext: inContext[engine][viewport] = { strip, buttons, rows:[{ state, pmid }], identity, dimCount }

notes: Font normalized by setting --int-font-ui on <html> after load, before any fixture or route is opened.
Stage: fixed full-screen div #probe-stage, padding 40px, background var(--int-bg-island). Contexts: default = no data-text-scale attribute.

States: rest (pointer at 1,1, nothing focused), hover (pointer at centre), active (button held down at centre, record, then moved away and released outside), focus (sentinel + Tab, or Alt+Tab in WebKit; matches(:focus-visible) verified).

extras.count: the first <b> of a chip relative to the chip border box. extras.wrapper: .tip-target relative to the .dim border box. extras.glyph: sorted unique fill|stroke of every path, circle inside the svg.

Keyboard traces: real Pods route at 1440x900, 3.5 s, pressed Tab is Alt+Tab (Alt+Shift+Tab) in WebKit; prevented = defaultPrevented seen by a bubble-phase window keydown listener added after load (null: no non-modifier keydown seen).
Themes: <html data-theme> set directly: void = attribute removed, high-contrast-dark = hc-dark, high-contrast-light = hc-light.
inContext: fresh page per viewport and engine, Pods route opened, 3.5 s, no mouse move; rects rounded to 0.01.
roving stops: prev = More actions for Pods, prev-2 = Refresh Pods, next = Search Pods (the brief's 'prev', Refresh Pods, is prev-2)
independence: cases/status-running/scale125/rest: chromium/1440x900 vs webkit/1440x900: label.top; chromium/1030x720 vs webkit/1440x900: label.top
cases/status-error/scale125/rest: chromium/1440x900 vs webkit/1440x900: label.top; chromium/1030x720 vs webkit/1440x900: label.top
cases/none-default/scale125/rest: chromium/1440x900 vs webkit/1440x900: h; chromium/1030x720 vs webkit/1440x900: h
